---
title: "Every school"
subtitle: "Value Added v2.0 for every state-funded mainstream secondary school in England, by pupil group."
toc: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "site_helpers.R"))
V <- load_va()
w <- va_wide(V)
```

Value added is in Attainment 8 points against England, averaged over a
school's years (`r yl(min(V$spec$years))` to `r yl(max(V$spec$years))`) and
shrunk by its reliability. A school whose interval for all pupils lies
wholly above or below zero is marked. Search by name, town or authority,
and sort by any column. The full data, with intervals for every group and
the within-authority version, are in
[va_v2_schools.csv](data/va_v2_schools.csv). Ofsted is the latest
judgement in Ofsted's data as at `r format(V$ofsted_as_at, "%d %B %Y")`.

```{r tbl}
r1 <- function(x) round(x, 1)
w |>
  arrange(desc(va_shrunk_all)) |>
  transmute(School = SCHNAME, Town = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(TOWN)), `Local authority` = LANAME,
            `All pupils` = r1(va_shrunk_all),
            `95% interval` = ifelse(is.na(va_lo_all), "", sprintf("%+.1f to %+.1f", va_lo_all, va_hi_all)),
            ` ` = case_when(va_lo_all > 0 ~ "above", va_hi_all < 0 ~ "below", TRUE ~ ""),
            Disadvantaged = r1(va_shrunk_disadvantaged), `Non-disadv.` = r1(va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged),
            Girls = r1(va_shrunk_girls), Boys = r1(va_shrunk_boys),
            `v1 (published)` = r1(v1_all), Years = years_all, `Ofsted latest` = ofsted_latest) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Responsive",
                options = list(pageLength = 25, autoWidth = TRUE, order = list(list(3, "desc")),
                               columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = 3:11))))
```
